stories.title: “Totally unacceptable” that Rhuallt and Tremeirchion water supply problems persist
stories.summary: Residents in two Denbighshire villages have complained of persistent water supply problems following a series of bursts to a water main. People living in Rhuallt and Tremeirchion have been dealing with low water pressure or intermittent supply issues. Tremeirchion councillor Chris Evans described the issues as “totally unacceptable”. stories.title: Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct to get a health and wellbeing hub
stories.summary: A health and wellbeing hub is to open in Mold town centre, part-funded by a Welsh Government regeneration grant. The hub is being set up by Hughes Pharmacy. It has received capital funding through the Welsh Government’s Transforming Towns programme, which Flintshire County Council’s regeneration team administers.
